question: Should Twilio RCS ship as a bundled OpenClaw channel, or should it be distributed as an external ClawHub plugin using the existing channel-plugin API?
rationale: The patch is not a narrow repair: it creates a new transport, configuration/credential surface, persisted operational state, and a provider-specific dependency commitment. Repository policy prefers the external path when current plugin seams are adequate, but only maintainers can sponsor an exception for a bundled official channel.

options.title: Move RCS to ClawHub
options.body: Package the existing channel-plugin implementation externally and keep OpenClaw core limited to the generic plugin seam.

options.title: Sponsor a bundled RCS channel
options.body: Accept the permanent Twilio RCS core surface, authorize the exact dependency graph, and require fresh-install, upgrade, and approved-sender/device proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Move RCS to ClawHub
recommendation.body: Package the existing channel-plugin implementation externally and keep OpenClaw core limited to the generic plugin seam.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent bundled Twilio SMS channel that is the strongest precedent for deciding whether the RCS sibling belongs in core.
